model-selector.description: Controlled model selection with relative ratings, extended thinking and web search settings.
model-selector.behaviorBody: The host provides model availability and the complete selected value. Choosing a model preserves conversation settings; choosing the current model only closes the panel. Keyboard highlight follows host selection changes and returns to an available option when a model is removed or disabled. Examples use fictional local models and do not send requests. Existing model-selector-01 component, types, labels and demo exports remain compatible. New controls import directly from model-selector.
model-selector.modelsProp: Unique ID, name, description and decorative icon; optional disabled state and relative speed, quality and cost ratings from 1 to 5. Higher cost means greater expense.
model-selector.valueProp: Controlled object with modelId, extendedThinking and webSearch. The callback returns the full next value.
model-selector.openProp: Controlled or default panel visibility. Opening preserves focus and restores the current available selection.
model-selector.disabledProp: Disables the trigger and hides the panel. Individual unavailable models are skipped by keyboard navigation.
model-selector.labelsProp: Partial localized labels; English and Chinese label objects are exported. locale and currency remain accepted for compatibility.
model-selector.placementProp: Popover direction and alignment; className controls trigger placement and external layout.
